audience: fundraisers and nonprofit teams who run online campaigns with Raisely

useCases.title: Compare our fundraising campaigns
useCases.text: Lists campaigns, reads one by id or path, and lists its fundraising profiles (individual and team pages), so you can compare them.

useCases.title: List recent donations for a campaign
useCases.text: Lists donations, filtered by campaign, status and sort order, so you can see who gave and how much.

useCases.title: Show the giving history of a donor
useCases.text: Finds a donor or supporter, then lists the donations that person made.

useCases.title: Review recurring donations
useCases.text: Lists subscriptions, which are recurring donations, and reads one by uuid.

useCases.title: Record an offline donation
useCases.text: Records a cash or cheque donation with the amount in cents and the currency, so it appears with the online ones.

useCases.title: Look up or add a supporter
useCases.text: Finds supporters, or adds one by email. If the email already exists, the supporter is updated and no duplicate is made.
